name: saascity
description: Plan a product launch from your agent: audit a homepage before launch, pick launch directories from 1,600+ with Ahrefs DR, link type and price, and list the product on SaaSCity.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No account or API key needed.

examples.title: Pre-launch audit
examples.prompt: Audit https://example.com before I launch it.

examples.title: Pick directories
examples.description: Choose launch directories by DR and link type
examples.prompt: Find free dofollow launch directories with DR above 50 for my AI tool.
